claim_scope: Exact singular multiset; sharp Schatten threshold; logarithmic cutoff and sorted singular-trace coefficient on power-weighted balls.
integrity: Same-model mathematical reconstruction and reproducibility checks; no independent validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite real trigonometric log-radial profiles only; fixed standard power weights and coordinate multiplication.
The statement does not apply to arbitrary bounded periodic or nonperiodic boundary profiles.
An equivalent construction in older operator-ideal literature cannot be completely excluded.
title: Log-periodic Bergman Toeplitz commutators have a measurable critical singular trace
